found.truth_sql: SELECT sumOrNull(t.n_dec) AS c0 FROM shop.typed_events t WHERE (NOT (startsWith(t.n_str, 'bet') OR (toStartOfMonth(toTimeZone(t.ts_utc, 'America/New_York')) >= addMonths(toStartOfMonth(now('America/New_York')), -2) AND toStartOfMonth(toTimeZone(t.ts_utc, 'America/New_York')) < toStartOfMonth(now('America/New_York'))) OR ((((toDayOfWeek(toTimeZone(t.n_ts, 'America/New_York')) - 0 + 7) % 7) + 1) = 1))) SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
